response.sql: WITH driver_averages AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM driver_averages) SELECT d.driverId, d.avg_points, d.avg_wins, d.avg_wins - o.mean_wins AS wins_difference FROM driver_averages AS d CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_difference DESC NULLS LAST, d.driverId LIMIT 10
